patch_description: This redesigned program extends the highly-efficient current architecture by introducing a second structured RY layer with orthogonal grouping after the post-entanglement RZ block. While the initial RY and RZ layers use even/odd pairing (qubits [0,2,4,6]→"a" and [1,3,5,7]→"b"), the new final RY layer uses cross-paired grouping (qubits [0,2,4,6]→"ry_final_c" and [1,3,5,7]→"ry_final_d"). This captures rotational modes missed by the single even/odd pattern, enriching local expressivity without bloating the parameter count. The new layer adds only 2 parameters while preserving the fast convergence (180 steps) and minimal generalization gap achieved by aggressive parameter sharing. Total parameters increase from 50 to 52, maintaining parameter efficiency while improving expressivity through structural diversity.
